question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Hill stations like Darjeeling and Nainital offer ________ to weary tourists during summer.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Solace'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Solace** means a person or place that makes you feel better or happier when you are** sad, tired, or disappointed.**

** • Example- ** He took solace from a world he could not control.

 
• So it is clear that** 'Solace'** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Strain** means pressure that is put on something when it is pulled or pushed by a physical force.
 
• **Activity** means a situation in which there is a lot of action or movement.
 
• **Aid** means a person or thing that helps you.

Therefore the correct answer is **option 3.**
